content:
OTP (One-Time Password) হলো সবচেয়ে ব্যবহৃত দ্বিতীয় স্তরের নিরাপত্তা মেকানিজম। কিন্তু ভুলভাবে implement করা OTP সিস্টেম otp bypass, brute force এবং replay attack-এর শিকার হয়।

---

OTP Generation Test Cases

TC-OTP-001: Request OTP for valid phone/email
Method: POST /api/otp/send
Body: { "identifier": "01712345678", "purpose": "login" }
Expected:
  - Status: 200 OK
  - OTP sent to phone (do not return OTP in response!)
  - Message: "OTP sent successfully."
  - DB: new OTP record created with expiry timestamp

TC-OTP-002: OTP is exactly 6 digits (if 6-digit OTP enforced)
Steps: Request OTP, check via test hook or email
Expected: OTP is numeric, exactly 6 characters

TC-OTP-003: OTP uniqueness
Request two OTPs in sequence
Expected: Second OTP differs from first (not predictable)
---

OTP Verification Test Cases

TC-OTP-004: Verify with correct OTP within expiry time
Method: POST /api/otp/verify
Body: { "identifier": "01712345678", "otp": "123456" }
Expected:
  - Status: 200 OK
  - OTP marked as used in DB (cannot be reused)

TC-OTP-005: Verify with wrong OTP
Body: { "otp": "000000" }
Expected: 400 Bad Request, "Invalid OTP."

TC-OTP-006: Verify expired OTP
Steps: Request OTP, wait for expiry (e.g., 5 min), then verify
Expected: 400 or 410 Gone, "OTP has expired. Please request a new one."

TC-OTP-007: Replay attack — reuse already verified OTP
Steps: Verify OTP successfully, then send same OTP again
Expected: 400, "OTP already used." (should not verify twice)
---

Security & Rate Limiting Test Cases

TC-OTP-008: Brute force — try all combinations
Steps: Send 1000+ wrong OTP attempts
Expected:
  - After 5 failed attempts: 429 Too Many Requests
  - Account/phone temporarily blocked for N minutes

TC-OTP-009: OTP not exposed in API response
Steps: Inspect /api/otp/send response body carefully
Expected: Response does NOT contain the OTP value in any field

TC-OTP-010: Resend limit enforcement
Steps: Request OTP 6 times within 1 minute
Expected: After 3-5 requests: 429, "Too many OTP requests. Try again later."

TC-OTP-011: OTP for invalid phone number
Body: { "identifier": "00000000000" }
Expected: 400 or 404, appropriate error — OTP NOT sent
---

পরিশেষে

OTP টেস্টিংয়ের সবচেয়ে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ দিক হলো Security — OTP response-এ expose না হওয়া, reuse না হওয়া এবং brute force ঠেকানো। এই তিনটি নিশ্চিত করতে পারলে OTP system production-ready।

Tags: #OTPTesting #APITesting #BruteForce #ReplayAttack #2FA #Security #QA
